Gideon, I haven't made the mail draft yet. Mateo's address is outside pemberline.com, and mail to outside addresses needs Ruth Calloway's approval, even as a draft. I've logged that approval request and asked Ruth here. Once she approves, I can save the draft to your mailbox for you to send.

Here is the proposed text, with no To line yet:

> Hi Mateo,
>
> Summary of the Hartford gate kiosk incident from Aug 3:
>
> - Around 10:42 AM, the gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Scheduling through the dispatch office still worked; the impact was on gate check-in.
> - Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM. Both lanes were working as of 11:07 AM.
> - Your account could not open the status page. That access issue is tracked in ticket INC-4821.
>
> Carrowmere Cloud checked the Hartford gateway route, and the reconnect logs have been shared with them.
>
> Best,
> Gideon

@Ruth Calloway, can you approve sending this draft to Mateo Quiroga at mateoquiroga@vantorre-group.example? The text contains no finance figures.
